summary.text: The heaven attached fungi field is a stretch of rank six heaven attached fungi inside immemorial black heaven where Central Continent's expedition stops to rest, and where a star cloud storm closes on them.

claims.text: Two hours after escaping a soul beast army, Bi Chen Tian spots a huge field of heaven attached fungi three thousand li away, and the three Immortal Gu Houses land on it to rest. Heaven attached fungi is a rank six immortal material unique to the immemorial nine heavens that only grows where no other life form, dao mark, or even rock can exist, so a field of it marks a safe resting place; Yu Yi Ye Zi leaves the Immortal Gu House to gather some while Bu Zhen Zi stays at Zhao Lian Yun’s side and Zhao Lian Yun herself has no interest in it. A huge star cloud storm approaches soon after the three Immortal Gu Houses land, and Bi Chen Tian says it now seems the heaven attached fungi field was a trap to lure them into resting there.
